# Workshop & Client Forms

![_Templates.  Jewelry Templates. Workshop & Client Forms. AP | Pivtorak.Studio. 30.10.2026_ © Anna Pivtorak (Kostyuk)](/images/templates-jewelry-templates-workshop-and-client-forms.webp)

*Workshop Operations & Customer Service*

Workshop and Client Forms present the basic documentation used when receiving jewelry orders, accepting items for repair, recording their existing condition, confirming agreed requirements, and handing completed work back to customers. These educational templates introduce the structure and purpose of common workshop and customer service documents. They help students understand how information about a jewelry item, its condition, the requested work, and customer approval is recorded throughout the service process. The materials are simplified for learning and interpretation rather than intended as complete professional or legally binding workshop forms.

## Customer Order & Design Brief

A simplified form for recording a customer's initial order and design requirements. It introduces the basic information that may be collected when discussing a new jewelry piece, including the type of item, intended purpose, design preferences, materials, gemstones, and other relevant details. The template helps students understand how an initial customer request is translated into a structured design brief.

## Jewelry Repair Intake Form

A form for documenting the receipt of an existing jewelry item for repair. It introduces the basic information associated with a repair request, including item identification, the customer's description of the problem, the requested service, and the date of intake. The template helps distinguish the customer's reported concerns from the workshop's subsequent assessment of the item.

## Existing Item Condition Report

A document for recording the visible condition of a jewelry item before any repair, alteration, or other work begins. It introduces the description of surface condition, visible damage, structural features, gemstone settings, and other relevant observations. The template helps students understand why an item's initial condition should be documented separately from the customer's repair request.

## Customer Approval & Authorization Form

A form for recording the customer's approval of the proposed design, agreed specifications, or planned repair work. It introduces the relationship between the initial request, the agreed scope of work, and the customer's confirmation. The template helps students understand how important decisions and approved parameters can be documented before work proceeds.

## Delivery & Collection Record

A document for recording the return or collection of a completed jewelry item. It introduces the basic information associated with the handover, including item identification, delivery date, accompanying components, and confirmation of receipt. The template helps students understand the final stage of the customer service process and the importance of documenting the transfer of an item.
